user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate the safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Generative AI foundation models training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform actions for user requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests and interactions via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply for user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could potentially contribute to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered for generative AI model development and training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: ClaudeBot with Disallow: / in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content in response to Claude user queries.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests retrieving web content directly directed by Claude AI users.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: Claude-User with Disallow: / in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance the relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: Claude-SearchBot with Disallow: / in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google search indexes, features, and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images, logos, and favicons for Google products.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search image features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Googlebot-Image or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for Google search features and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Googlebot-Video or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content specifically for Google News surfaces and apps.
user_agents.scope: Affects the Google News product, including news.google.com and Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Googlebot-News or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls surfaces and product content for Google Shopping.
user_agents.scope: Affects all surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Powers Search testing tools such as URL Inspection and Rich Result Test.
user_agents.scope: Affects Search testing tools in Search Console; has no effect on Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for internal research, development, and one-off fetches.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible site content used across various Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Optimized for fetching publicly accessible image URLs without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Optimized for fetching publicly accessible video URLs without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Executes crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects crawls requested for Vertex AI Agents; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of site content for Gemini training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Controls training for Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules targeting Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Collect and index data from the internet automatically.
user_agents.scope: Web indexing and search crawler operations.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules targeting PerplexityBot.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather information in response to user requests.
user_agents.scope: User-triggered data fetching and indexing operations.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules targeting Perplexity-User.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products and collects data for foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web search results in Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and Apple generative AI features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of web data for training Apple foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Generative AI features across Apple products including Apple Intelligence, Services, and Developer Tools.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content of apps or websites shared on Meta apps.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays information about shared links, such as title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, though it may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance, accuracy, and citations in Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and business products.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for use cases like improving advertising and other business-related products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web for training foundation AI models and improving products.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and improves agentic AI.
user_agents.scope: Fetches user-requested links and helps AI navigate websites to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for product improvements and AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amazonbot in robots.txt or use noarchive/noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Enables content to appear in search experiences like Alexa without AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amzn-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions like responding to Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live web info on user demand; no generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide open web data for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Automated crawling of a randomly selected subset of the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow CCBot in robots.txt or request addition to the opt-out registry.
